summary: LMS Advisory is a Parramatta CPA-led accounting and advisory firm run by Managing Director Alexander Laureti. It lists Month End Close and bank and credit card reconciliations among its services and works across MYOB, Xero and QuickBooks. Laureti has spoken publicly about wanting software to handle manual processing, and his LinkedIn headline includes 'AI+'.

hooks.text: Alexander has said he wants software to handle manual processing so staff do higher-value work, and his headline says AI+: receptive to automation.
Month End Close is a listed service and juniors reconcile across MYOB, Xero and QuickBooks: reconciliation load is multi-platform.
Separate bookkeeping arm (Keep My Books Online) means reconciliation volume sits across two teams.

risks.text: Alexander already uses automation (Cerebiz) so may compare Vert to existing tools (2021 source).
